reviewer: Author's editorial pass, 2026-09-18: research subagents fetched and quoted each source; every quoted passage was re-fetched independently and matched verbatim before scoring. First-person incident notes; external sources ground the mechanisms named, not the incidents themselves.
reviewNotes: Original contribution is the rule for shared chrome and the corrected fix. The first fix (render on demand) was revised after reading the cited live-region guidance; the note now records that revision honestly. Limits section states verification was against tests and specification text, not a screen reader session.

claims.text: The [status role](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#status) is a live region with an implicit polite politeness
claims.sourcePassage: Elements with the role status have an implicit aria-live value of polite and an implicit aria-atomic value of true.
claims.limitation: Normative definition of the role; the specification does not address how many live regions a page should contain.

claims.text: [Playwright locators are strict](https://playwright.dev/docs/locators#strictness): an operation that resolves to more than one element throws
claims.sourcePassage: Locators are strict. This means that all operations on locators that imply some target DOM element will throw an exception if more than one element matches.
claims.limitation: Applies to element-targeting operations; some operations such as count are exempt.

claims.text: establish the region before updating its content, because assistive technology announces changes, not arrivals
claims.sourcePassage: Assistive technologies will generally only announce dynamic changes in the content of a live region. Establish the live region before updating its content.
claims.limitation: Practitioner guidance; behaviour varies across browser and assistive technology pairings and was not tested here.

claims.text: Before adding one, ask what it does to a page that already has its own.
claims.rationale: Author's rule for shared components; a heuristic, not a measured finding.
